proof_body:
by
  intro n
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, ∏ i ∈ Finset.range m, (i + 1) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), Nat.stirlingFirst m k := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      have h0 : m * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), m.stirlingFirst (k + 1) = m * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), m.stirlingFirst k := by
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ _ m, Finset.sum_range_succ' _ m, Nat.stirlingFirst_eq_zero_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self m)]
        cases m with
        | zero => simp
        | succ j => simp
      rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ' _ (m + 1), Nat.stirlingFirst_succ_zero, add_zero]
      simp only [Nat.stirlingFirst_succ_succ]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, h0]
      ring
  rw [← key, Finset.prod_range_add_one_eq_factorial]
target_source: ∀ n : ℕ, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Nat.stirlingFirst n k = n.factorial
